caseName: Lonchar v. Georgia Board of Pardons & Paroles
caseNameFull: Lonchar v. Georgia Board of Pardons and Paroles

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ga. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied. The order heretofore entered by Justice Kennedy is vacated.
